entries.zh: 段；段落（祈祷文、省察之分段、分点）
entries.en: a section or point, as of a prayer or of the examination of conscience

entries.notes: 仅西语残行“Punto puntillo…”（点、小点）可辨，汉字、闽南音写、官话栏皆空，后半疑为上页词条接续，无从确证对应词义。
西语栏严重残损（“Puntrual…”疑为 puntual，与汉字“結局”义不合），释义主要依据汉字栏“結局”及闽南音写栏 can-quee-tziog。

entries.zh: 财上分明大丈夫（钱财来往分明、付账守信，方是正人君子）
entries.en: punctual in paying, like an honourable man — Chin. proverb: he that keeps clear in money matters is a true man

entries.zh: 捻：一捻、一小撮（以指捻取之少量）
entries.en: a pinch; a small handful taken between the fingers (puñado)

entries.zh: 一把（量词，如一把糖）；抓一把、满把
entries.en: a handful (of sugar); the measure ba; to seize and take a handful (apuñar)

entries.zh: 匕首；短刀（近身短刃之器）
entries.en: a dagger; a short blade of the machete kind

entries.zh: 殴：殴打；以拳相殴（双手并击）
entries.en: to strike; to give blows with the fists, with both hands

entries.zh: 竞：争竞、相争（争斗较量胜负）
entries.en: to contend; to fight it out, exchange blows

entries.zh: 凶拳：凶狠的拳打、挥拳猛击
entries.en: a furious blow of the fist; to rain punches (Sp. moxicones)

entries.zh: 金拳头：金拳（西文注文谓中国国王之兵器，音写栏残缺）
entries.en: a golden fist — noted as a weapon of the King of China

entries.zh: 痢药：泻药、通便之药；亦指治痢之剂
脱药：攻泻通便之药、泻下剂
entries.en: a purgative — medicine that expels and cleanses the bowels

entries.zh: 脱泻：泻下、通泄（服泻药而通便除积）
entries.en: purgation; an evacuation of the bowels, to purge
